subject.title: fix(heartbeat): allow cron-triggered wakes regardless of per-agent heartbeat config

question: Should cron-owned main-session systemEvent wakes bypass per-agent heartbeat scheduler omission when global heartbeats are enabled?
rationale: The code fix is bounded, but it changes the meaning of explicit per-agent heartbeat configuration for cron-triggered wakes, and automation cannot decide that compatibility policy for existing users.

options.title: Require proof, then accept cron override
options.body: Ask for a redacted installed or live cron transcript showing the bug fixed, then accept cron scheduling as the owner of these wakes while global heartbeat disable remains authoritative.

options.title: Accept without more proof
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the compatibility change based on source and test evidence, while owning the residual live-proof gap.

options.title: Keep per-agent omission authoritative
options.body: If omitting an agent from heartbeat config must suppress cron wakes too, pause this PR and keep the linked issue open for a different fix shape.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then accept cron override
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted installed or live cron transcript showing the bug fixed, then accept cron scheduling as the owner of these wakes while global heartbeat disable remains authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent cross-boundary signal across heartbeat summary/gate behavior and adjacent cron systemEvent delivery work.
